name: Exiva map
about: Draws each team exiva result on your in-game minimap: the whole area where the target can be, from the answers of all your characters.
points: Your own cast shows at once, the team's answers make it smaller
The whole area, also over land nobody has explored
A dotted outline for each answer, and a colour per name
A pointer at the edge of the game view: the way, the distance and the floor
Fades after 30 seconds, up to 3 names at once
